```renyi
public function statement_line(order: Invoice) returns Text
  purpose: One row of the statement: customer, number of lines and total, in fixed columns.
  example: statement_line(Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [], discount_percent: 0))
    is "ACME          0 lines      0.00"

  let line_count be order.lines.length()
  let line_word be if line_count is 1 then "line" otherwise "lines" end
  let line_text be "{line_count} {line_word}"

  let total_value be invoice.total(order)
  let raw_total be total_value.to_text()
  let mutable total_text be raw_total

  if raw_total.contains(".") then
    let total_parts be raw_total.split(".")
    let whole_digits be total_parts.first() otherwise raw_total
    let decimal_digits be total_parts.last() otherwise ""

    if decimal_digits.length() is 0 then
      set total_text to "{whole_digits}.00"
    otherwise if decimal_digits.length() is 1 then
      set total_text to "{whole_digits}.{decimal_digits}0"
    otherwise if decimal_digits.length() is greater than 2 then
      set total_text to "{whole_digits}.{decimal_digits.take(2)}"
    end
  otherwise
    set total_text to "{raw_total}.00"
  end

  let customer_spaces be " ".repeat((14 - order.customer.length()).at_least(0))
  let line_spaces be " ".repeat((13 - line_text.length()).at_least(0))

  return "{order.customer}{customer_spaces}{line_text}{line_spaces}{total_text}"
end
```

```renyi
public function statement_line(order: Invoice) returns Text
  purpose: One row of the statement: customer, number of lines and total, in fixed columns.
  example: statement_line(Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [], discount_percent: 0))
    is "ACME          0 lines      0.00"

  let customer_column be order.customer.pad_right(14)
  let line_count be order.lines.length()
  let line_word be if line_count is 1 then "line" otherwise "lines" end
  let lines_column be "{line_count} {line_word}".pad_right(13)

  let raw_total be invoice.total(order).to_text()
  let decimal_index be raw_total.index_of(".") otherwise 0 - 1
  let places be if decimal_index is 0 - 1 then 0 otherwise raw_total.length() - decimal_index - 1 end
  let total_column be
    if decimal_index is 0 - 1 then "{raw_total}.00"
    otherwise raw_total + "0".repeat(2 - places)
    end

  return "{customer_column}{lines_column}{total_column}"
end
```

```renyi
public function statement_line(order: Invoice) returns Text
  purpose: One row of the statement: customer, number of lines and total, in fixed columns.
  example: statement_line(Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [], discount_percent: 0))
    is "ACME          0 lines      0.00"

  let customer_column be order.customer.pad_right(14)
  let line_count be order.lines.length()
  let line_column be "{line_count} lines"
  let total_raw be invoice.total(order).to_text()
  let mutable total_text be total_raw

  if not total_raw.contains(".") then
    set total_text to "{total_raw}.00"
  otherwise
    let total_parts be total_raw.split(".")
    let fraction be total_parts.last() otherwise crash with "decimal text split failed"

    if fraction.length() is 0 then
      set total_text to "{total_raw}00"
    otherwise if fraction.length() is 1 then
      set total_text to "{total_raw}0"
    end
  end

  return "{customer_column}{line_column}{total_text.pad_left(10)}"
end
```
